|-|Tips=
{{Achievement|Texas Treasures, Part 2|jpg|In the [[Lost In Transit]] job, find the hidden safe locked with the sheriff star and steal the content.}}
To complete this achievement, the player must have completed the [[Achievements (Payday 2)/MidlandRanch|Texas Treasures]] achievement on [[Midland Ranch]] and have the sheriff star in their inventory.
[[File:Texas Treasures pt2 1.png|thumb|right]]
The first part of this achievement can be found on a stack of containers near the turntable. By jumping from different crates up and onto the far stack of containers, players will find a toolbox with a key labeled "Container 42".
[[File:Texas Treasures pt2 2.png|thumb|right]]
The player must then find container 42, which can be found near the entrance of the rail yard. By jumping from the top of a traincar to a small ledge on the side of the container. Upon opening the container, players will find a safe locked with a star. Using the sheriff star, players can open the safe and collect the usb drive inside.
{{clr}}
|-|Trivia=
*'''The Payday Express''' is likely a reference to a children book/film, '''The Polar Express'''.
*'''Workin' On The Railroad''' is a reference to the American folk song {{w|I've Been Working on the Railroad}}.
*'''I Like Trains''' is a reference to a running gag in the YouTube series 'asdfmovie'.
*'''Texas Treasures, Part 2''' is a continuation of the '''Texas Treasures''' achievement of the [[Midland Ranch]] heist.
*'''Tabula Railroad''' is similar to the 'Tabula Rasa' achievement in the [[Hoxton Breakout]] heist, as both share a similar name and similar requirements.
*'''Billy The Kid''' references Henry McCarty, also known as {{w|Billy the Kid}}, an American outlaw and gunfighter during the Wild West era.
*The container #42 in '''Texas Treasures Part 2''' is a reference to The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, as "the answer to the Ultimate Question of Life, the Universe, and Everything."
